```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(Rlgt)
library(forecast)

# Fixed blgt_forecast_from_zero with better randomization
blgt_forecast_from_zero_fixed <- function(rv, h, ns = 1e+06, 
                                          initial_level = NULL,
                                          initial_trend = NULL,
                                          initial_seasonal = NULL,
                                          initial_error = NULL,
                                          seed = 42) {
  
  # set seed to allow different scenarios
  if (!is.null(seed)) {
    set.seed(seed)
  }
  
  # Get model parameters
  n = length(rv$y)
  n.samples = rv$n.samples
  m = rv$m  # seasonality period
  
  # get different draws
  I = sample(n.samples, ns, replace = TRUE)
  
  # allow customised trend
  if (!is.null(initial_trend)) {
    bS = rep(initial_trend, ns)
  } else {
    bS = rv$bt[I]  #Original: Uses last values from training data
  }
  
  #allow customised level
  if (!is.null(initial_level)) {
    prev.level = rep(initial_level, ns)
  } else {
    prev.level = rv$lt[I]  # Original: Uses last values from training data
  }
  
  #allow customised error
  if (!is.null(initial_error)) {
    error = rep(initial_error, ns)
  } else {
    error = rv$et[I] # Original: Uses last values from training data
  }
  
  # forecast matrix
  yf = matrix(0, ns, h)
  
  # Handle seasonality
  seasonal = FALSE
  if (m > 1) {
    seasonal = TRUE
    log.s = matrix(0, ns, m + h)
    y.on.l = matrix(0, ns, m + h)
    
    # allow customisable seasonality
    if (!is.null(initial_seasonal) && length(initial_seasonal) >= m) {
      for (j in 1:m) {
        log.s[, j] = log(initial_seasonal[j])
      }
      y.on.l[, 1:m] = 0
    } else {
      log.s[, 1:m] = rv$log.s[I, ]  # Original: Always uses seasonal from end of training
      y.on.l[, 1:m] = rv$y.on.l[I, ]
    }
  }
  
  # Generate forecasts - each path will be different due to different I samples
  for (i in 1:h) {
    if (seasonal) {
      log.s[, i + m] = rv$zeta[I] * y.on.l[, i] + (1 - rv$zeta[I]) * log.s[, i]
      log.s[, i + m] = 4 * 1/(1 + exp(-log.s[, i + m])) - 2
    }
    
    l = prev.level
    #rho
    if (seasonal) {
      exp.val = exp(log.s[, i + m]) * (l + rv$w[I, 1] * l^rv$rho[I] + rv$w[I, 2] * bS)
    } else {
      exp.val = l + rv$w[I, 1] * l^rv$rho[I] + rv$w[I, 2] * bS
    }
    #tau xi2 sigma2
    scale = sqrt(rv$xi2[I] + rv$sigma2[I] * l^(2 * rv$tau[I]))
    
    # Generate different random errors for each sample
    e = rt(ns, rv$nu[I]) * scale
    
    yf[, i] = pmax(pmin(exp.val + e, 1e+38), 0.001)
    # alpha
    if (seasonal) {
      cur.level = pmax(0.001, rv$alpha[I] * yf[, i]/exp(log.s[, i + m]) + 
                         (1 - rv$alpha[I]) * prev.level)
    } else {
      cur.level = pmax(0.001, rv$alpha[I] * yf[, i] + (1 - rv$alpha[I]) * prev.level)
    }
    
    idx <- which(yf[, i] <= 0.001)
    cur.level[idx] <- prev.level[idx]
    
    if (seasonal) {
      y.on.l[, i + m] = log(yf[, i]/cur.level)
      y.on.l[idx, i + m] <- y.on.l[idx, i]
    }
    #beta
    bS = rv$beta[I] * (cur.level - prev.level) + (1 - rv$beta[I]) * bS
    prev.level = cur.level
  }
  
  # Return different quantiles to show variation
  list(
    yf.med = apply(yf, 2, function(x) { quantile(x, 0.5) }),
    yf.CI05 = apply(yf, 2, function(x) { quantile(x, 0.025) }),
    yf.CI95 = apply(yf, 2, function(x) { quantile(x, 0.975) }),
    yf = yf
  )
}

# Helper function to detect frequency from timestamps
detect_frequency <- function(timestamps) {
  
  if (length(timestamps) < 2) {
    return(12)  # Default to monthly
  }
  
  # Convert to proper datetime format if needed
  timestamps <- parse_timestamps(timestamps)
  
  # Calculate differences between consecutive timestamps
  time_diffs <- as.numeric(diff(sort(timestamps)))
  median_diff <- median(time_diffs, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Classify based on median difference
  if (inherits(timestamps[1], "POSIXt")) {
    if (median_diff <= 3600) {
      return(24)
    } else if (median_diff <= 86400) {
      return(365)
    } else if (median_diff <= 604800) {
      return(52)
    } else if (median_diff <= 2678400) {
      return(12)
    } else if (median_diff <= 7776000) {
      return(4)
    } else {
      return(1)
    }
  } else {
    if (median_diff < 1.5) {
      return(365)
    } else if (median_diff < 8) {
      return(52)
    } else if (median_diff < 35) {
      return(12)
    } else if (median_diff < 100) {
      return(4)
    } else {
      return(1)
    }
  }
}

# Helper function to parse various timestamp formats
parse_timestamps <- function(timestamps) {
  
  tryCatch({
    if (is.character(timestamps) || is.factor(timestamps)) {
      timestamps <- as.character(timestamps)
      
      if (all(grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}$", timestamps[!is.na(timestamps)]))) {
        return(as.Date(paste0(timestamps, "-01")))
      }
      
      if (all(grepl("^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$", timestamps[!is.na(timestamps)]))) {
        return(as.Date(timestamps))
      }
      
      if (all(grepl("^\\d{4}$", timestamps[!is.na(timestamps)]))) {
        return(as.Date(paste0(timestamps, "-01-01")))
      }
      
      if (all(grepl("^\\d{4}-Q[1-4]$", timestamps[!is.na(timestamps)]))) {
        quarters <- gsub("^(\\d{4})-Q([1-4])$", "\\1-\\2", timestamps)
        quarters <- gsub("-1$", "-01-01", quarters)
        quarters <- gsub("-2$", "-04-01", quarters)
        quarters <- gsub("-3$", "-07-01", quarters)
        quarters <- gsub("-4$", "-10-01", quarters)
        return(as.Date(quarters))
      }
      
      datetime_result <- tryCatch({
        as.POSIXct(timestamps)
      }, error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if (!is.null(datetime_result) && !all(is.na(datetime_result))) {
        return(datetime_result)
      }
      
      return(as.Date(timestamps))
      
    } else if (is.numeric(timestamps)) {
      return(timestamps)
    } else {
      return(timestamps)
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Warning: Could not parse timestamps, using sequential numbers")
    return(seq_along(timestamps))
  })
}

# Helper function to generate future timestamps
# date_convention: "first" = start of period, "last" = end of period
generate_future_timestamps <- function(start_date, n_points, frequency,
                                       date_convention = "last") {
  
  tryCatch({
    if (inherits(start_date, "Date")) {
      
      if (frequency == 12) {
        # Monthly
        first_of_months <- seq(from = as.Date(format(start_date, "%Y-%m-01")),
                               length.out = n_points, by = "month")
        if (date_convention == "last") {
          # Last day of each month (Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, ...)
          return(as.Date(format(first_of_months + 31, "%Y-%m-01")) - 1)
        } else {
          # First day of each month (Jan 1, Feb 1, Mar 1, ...)
          return(first_of_months)
        }
        
      } else if (frequency == 4) {
        # Quarterly
        first_of_quarters <- seq(from = as.Date(format(start_date, "%Y-%m-01")),
                                 length.out = n_points, by = "3 months")
        if (date_convention == "last") {
          # Last day of Mar, Jun, Sep, Dec
          return(as.Date(format(first_of_quarters + 31, "%Y-%m-01")) - 1)
        } else {
          # First day of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct
          quarter_months <- c(1, 4, 7, 10)
          month_num <- as.numeric(format(start_date, "%m"))
          start_qm <- quarter_months[which.min(abs(quarter_months - month_num))]
          first_date <- as.Date(paste0(format(start_date, "%Y"), "-",
                                       sprintf("%02d", start_qm), "-01"))
          return(seq(from = first_date, length.out = n_points, by = "3 months"))
        }
        
      } else if (frequency == 1) {
        # Yearly
        years <- as.numeric(format(start_date, "%Y")) + 0:(n_points - 1)
        if (date_convention == "last") {
          # Dec 31
          return(as.Date(paste0(years, "-12-31")))
        } else {
          # Jan 1
          return(as.Date(paste0(years, "-01-01")))
        }
        
      } else if (frequency == 365) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "day"))
      } else if (frequency == 52) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "week"))
      } else {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "month"))
      }
      
    } else if (inherits(start_date, "POSIXt")) {
      if (frequency == 24) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "hour"))
      } else if (frequency == 365) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "day"))
      } else if (frequency == 52) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "week"))
      } else if (frequency == 12) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "month"))
      } else if (frequency == 4) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "quarter"))
      } else if (frequency == 1) {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "year"))
      } else {
        return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = "hour"))
      }
      
    } else if (is.numeric(start_date)) {
      time_step <- 1
      if (frequency == 24) time_step <- 1/24
      else if (frequency == 365) time_step <- 1
      else if (frequency == 52) time_step <- 7
      else if (frequency == 12) time_step <- 30
      else if (frequency == 4) time_step <- 91
      else if (frequency == 1) time_step <- 365
      
      return(seq(from = start_date, length.out = n_points, by = time_step))
      
    } else {
      return(seq_len(n_points))
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Warning: Using sequential timestamps due to error: ", e$message)
    return(seq_len(n_points))
  })
}

# Enhanced individual series generation function
generate_synthetic_series_individual <- function(series_data, n_synthetic = NULL, 
                                                 n_scenarios = 1, frequency = NULL,
                                                 control_params = NULL, first_fraction = 0.5) {
  
  # Extract series information
  series_name <- unique(series_data$series_name)[1]
  series_values <- series_data$series_value
  
  # Check for additional columns
  extra_cols <- setdiff(names(series_data), c("series_name", "start_timestamp", "series_value"))
  extra_data <- if(length(extra_cols) > 0) {
    series_data[1, extra_cols, drop = FALSE]
  } else {
    NULL
  }
  
  if (is.null(n_synthetic)) {
    n_synthetic <- length(series_values)
  }
  
  # Auto-detect frequency if not provided
  if (is.null(frequency)) {
    frequency <- detect_frequency(series_data$start_timestamp)
    message(paste("Auto-detected frequency:", frequency, "for series:", series_name))
  }
  
  # Convert to ts object
  ts_data <- ts(series_values, frequency = frequency)
  
  message(paste("Fitting RLGT model for series:", series_name))
  
  # Set control parameters
  if (is.null(control_params)) {
    control_params <- rlgt.control()
  }
  
  # Get original timestamp info for proper timestamp generation
  original_timestamps <- series_data$start_timestamp
  
  # Convert timestamps to proper format if needed
  if (is.character(original_timestamps) || is.factor(original_timestamps)) {
    original_timestamps <- parse_timestamps(original_timestamps)
  }
  
  original_timestamps <- sort(original_timestamps)
  start_date <- min(original_timestamps)
  
  tryCatch({
    # Fit model
    rlgt_model <- rlgt(
      y = ts_data,
      method = "Gibbs",
      control = control_params,
      verbose = FALSE
    )
    
    # Generate scenarios with different random paths
    scenarios_list <- list()
    
    for (scenario in 1:n_scenarios) {
      
      # 50/50 date convention: first half "first", second half "last"
      convention <- if (scenario <= n_scenarios * first_fraction) "first" else "last"
      
      # Generate different initial conditions for each scenario
      initial_level <- max(0, sample(series_values, 1) + 0.05 * sd(series_values) * rt(1, df = 3))
      initial_trend <- sample(diff(series_values), 1)
      
      # Handle seasonal components based on frequency
      if (frequency > 1) {
        initial_seasonal <- rep(1, frequency)
        n_obs <- length(series_values)
        
        if (n_obs >= frequency) {
          max_start <- n_obs - frequency + 1
          start_idx <- sample(1:max_start, 1)
          random_cycle <- series_values[start_idx:(start_idx + frequency - 1)]
          cycle_mean <- mean(random_cycle, na.rm = TRUE)
          if (cycle_mean > 0) {
            initial_seasonal <- random_cycle / cycle_mean
          }
        }
      } else {
        initial_seasonal <- NULL
      }
      
      # Generate a SINGLE path for this scenario
      n_paths <- 100
      
      synthetic_result <- blgt_forecast_from_zero_fixed(
        rv = rlgt_model,
        h = n_synthetic,
        ns = n_paths,
        initial_level = initial_level,
        initial_trend = initial_trend,
        initial_seasonal = initial_seasonal,
        seed = NULL  
      )
      
      # Pick a random path from the generated paths
      path_idx <- sample(1:n_paths, 1)
      synthetic_values <- synthetic_result$yf[path_idx, ]
      
      # Generate proper timestamps with 50/50 convention
      new_timestamps <- generate_future_timestamps(start_date, n_synthetic, 
                                                   frequency, convention)
      
      # Create scenario data with proper timestamps
      scenario_df <- data.frame(
        series_name = paste0(series_name, "_synthetic_", scenario),
        start_timestamp = new_timestamps,
        series_value = synthetic_values,
        original_series = series_name,
        scenario = scenario,
        frequency_detected = frequency,
        date_convention = convention,
        lower_95 = synthetic_result$yf.CI05,
        upper_95 = synthetic_result$yf.CI95
      )
      
      # Add extra columns if they exist
      if (!is.null(extra_data)) {
        for (col in names(extra_data)) {
          scenario_df[[col]] <- extra_data[[col]]
        }
      }
      
      scenarios_list[[scenario]] <- scenario_df
    }
    
    return(list(
      success = TRUE,
      scenarios = scenarios_list,
      model = rlgt_model,
      series_name = series_name,
      detected_frequency = frequency,
      initial_conditions = list(
        level = initial_level,
        trend = initial_trend,
        seasonal = initial_seasonal
      )
    ))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    message(paste("Error processing", series_name, ":", e$message))
    return(list(
      success = FALSE,
      error = e$message,
      series_name = series_name
    ))
  })
}

# Enhanced main generation function with auto-frequency detection
generate_synthetic_dataset_fixed <- function(data, n_synthetic = NULL, 
                                             n_scenarios = 1, frequency = NULL,
                                             parallel = TRUE, n_cores = NULL,
                                             control_params = NULL,
                                             series_column = "series_name",
                                             timestamp_column = "start_timestamp",
                                             value_column = "series_value", first_fraction = 0.5) {
  
  # Validate required columns
  required_cols <- c(series_column, timestamp_column, value_column)
  if (!all(required_cols %in% names(data))) {
    stop(paste("Missing required columns. Expected:", paste(required_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  }
  
  # Standardize column names
  data_std <- data
  names(data_std)[names(data_std) == series_column] <- "series_name"
  names(data_std)[names(data_std) == timestamp_column] <- "start_timestamp"
  names(data_std)[names(data_std) == value_column] <- "series_value"
  
  # Get unique series
  unique_series <- unique(data_std$series_name)
  n_series <- length(unique_series)
  
  message(paste("Processing", n_series, "series from dataset"))
  message(paste("Generating", n_scenarios, "scenarios per series"))
  message(paste0("Date convention split: ", round(first_fraction*100), "% 'first', ", round((1-first_fraction)*100), "% 'last'"))
  if (is.null(frequency)) {
    message("Auto-detecting frequency for each series")
  } else {
    message(paste("Using fixed frequency:", frequency))
  }
  
  # Process each series
  if (parallel && n_series > 1) {
    if (is.null(n_cores)) {
      n_cores <- min(parallel::detectCores() - 1, 4)
    }
    
    cl <- parallel::makeCluster(n_cores)
    parallel::clusterEvalQ(cl, {
      library(Rlgt)
      library(forecast)
    })
    
    # Export necessary functions
    parallel::clusterExport(cl, c("blgt_forecast_from_zero_fixed", 
                                  "generate_synthetic_series_individual",
                                  "detect_frequency",
                                  "parse_timestamps", 
                                  "generate_future_timestamps",
                                  "data_std", "n_synthetic", "n_scenarios", 
                                  "frequency", "control_params", "first_fraction"), 
                            envir = environment())
    
    results <- parallel::parLapply(cl, unique_series, function(series_name) {
      series_data <- data_std[data_std$series_name == series_name, ]
      generate_synthetic_series_individual(series_data, n_synthetic, n_scenarios, 
                                           frequency, control_params, first_fraction = first_fraction)
    })
    
    parallel::stopCluster(cl)
    
  } else {
    # Sequential processing
    results <- lapply(seq_along(unique_series), function(i) {
      if (i %% 10 == 0) {
        message(paste("Processing series", i, "of", n_series))
      }
      series_name <- unique_series[i]
      series_data <- data_std[data_std$series_name == series_name, ]
      generate_synthetic_series_individual(series_data, n_synthetic, n_scenarios, 
                                           frequency, control_params, first_fraction = first_fraction)
    })
  }
  
  # Process results
  successful_results <- results[sapply(results, function(x) x$success)]
  failed_results <- results[!sapply(results, function(x) x$success)]
  
  # Combine scenarios
  all_scenarios <- list()
  for (result in successful_results) {
    all_scenarios <- c(all_scenarios, result$scenarios)
  }
  
  # Create combined dataframe
  if (length(all_scenarios) > 0) {
    combined_df <- do.call(rbind, all_scenarios)
    
    # Restore original column names
    if (series_column != "series_name") {
      names(combined_df)[names(combined_df) == "series_name"] <- series_column
    }
    if (timestamp_column != "start_timestamp") {
      names(combined_df)[names(combined_df) == "start_timestamp"] <- timestamp_column
    }
    if (value_column != "series_value") {
      names(combined_df)[names(combined_df) == "series_value"] <- value_column
    }
  } else {
    combined_df <- data.frame()
  }
  
  message(paste("\nSuccessfully processed", length(successful_results), 
                "out of", n_series, "series"))
  
  return(list(
    synthetic_data = combined_df,
    successful_results = successful_results,
    failed_results = failed_results,
    summary = list(
      total_series = n_series,
      successful = length(successful_results),
      failed = length(failed_results),
      total_scenarios = length(all_scenarios),
      parameters = list(
        n_synthetic = n_synthetic,
        n_scenarios = n_scenarios,
        frequency = frequency,
        first_fraction = first_fraction
      )
    )
  ))
}

plot_series_with_scenarios <- function(original_data, synthetic_data, series_name, 
                                       show_confidence = TRUE, max_scenarios = 15) {
  
  # Get original series data
  orig_series <- original_data[original_data$series_name == series_name, ]
  
  # Get synthetic scenarios for this series
  synth_series <- synthetic_data[synthetic_data$original_series == series_name, ]
  
  if (nrow(synth_series) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No synthetic data found for series:", series_name))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  orig_series$type <- "Original"
  orig_series$scenario <- 0
  
  # Prepare synthetic data
  synth_plot <- synth_series[, c("start_timestamp", "series_value", "scenario")]
  synth_plot$type <- paste0("Scenario_", synth_plot$scenario)
  
  # Combine for plotting
  plot_data <- rbind(
    orig_series[, c("start_timestamp", "series_value", "type", "scenario")],
    synth_plot
  )
  
  # Create base plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    {if (show_confidence && "lower_95" %in% names(synth_series)) {
      conf_bands <- synth_series %>%
        group_by(start_timestamp) %>%
        summarise(
          lower = min(lower_95),
          upper = max(upper_95),
          .groups = 'drop'
        )
      geom_ribbon(data = conf_bands,
                  aes(x = start_timestamp, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                  alpha = 0.2, fill = "blue")
    }} +
    geom_line(data = plot_data[plot_data$type != "Original", ],
              aes(x = start_timestamp, y = series_value, 
                  group = type, color = as.factor(scenario)),
              alpha = 0.6, size = 0.8) +
    geom_line(data = plot_data[plot_data$type == "Original", ],
              aes(x = start_timestamp, y = series_value),
              color = "black", size = 1.2) +
    labs(title = paste("Original and Synthetic Scenarios:", series_name),
         x = "Time", y = "Value") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")   # <-- drop the per-scenario legend
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
synth_data <- subset(synthetic_m3_yearly$synthetic_data, series_name == series_name)

p_real <- ggplot(real_data, aes(x = start_timestamp, y = series_value)) +
  geom_line(color = "skyblue", linewidth = 1) +
  ggtitle(paste("Actual series:", series_name)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_synth <- ggplot(synth_data, aes(x = start_timestamp, y = series_value)) +
  geom_line(color = "skyblue", linewidth = 1) +
  ggtitle(paste("Synthetic series:", series_name)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_real)
print(p_synth)

```



```{r}

library(dplyr)

m3_yearly_syn<-synthetic_m3_yearly$synthetic_data
m3_yearly_syn$ts <- m3_yearly_syn$start_timestamp          # rename for clarity

m3_yearly_syn %>%
  mutate(series_id = paste(series_name, scenario, sep = "_"),
         ts        = start_timestamp) %>%           # keep the ordinal step
  select(series_id, ts, y = series_value) %>%       # drop other columns
  group_by(series_id) 


# Your monthly CIF data converts to:
m3_yearly_pfn_data <- m3_yearly_syn %>%
  select(
    id = series_name,        # series identifier
    ts = start_timestamp,    # 1,2,3,4... (monthly steps)
    y = series_value        # monthly values
  ) %>%
  mutate(noise = 1) %>%
  arrange(id, ts)



```

```{r}
write.csv(m3_yearly_pfn_data, "m3_yearly_new_200.csv")
```
